verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own Auto-Sync feature commits, pulls and pushes automatically whenever it detects changes, and Background Sync extends this while other apps are in use. That is a built-in event-triggered action, but it is a fixed toggle rather than user-defined rules. Shortcuts integration and x-callback-url are a host-platform capability and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: user-definable trigger/condition/action rules, choice of event types beyond file changes, configurable actions beyond fixed sync, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Auto-Sync does all of this for you, committing, pulling and pushing whenever changes are detected.
Turn on Background Sync to keep syncing while you use other apps
